short: Logical spacetime volume in qubits and T gates

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.arcsinSpacetime
lean.plain: T-gate count times data and ancilla width
lean.annotation: `arcsinSpacetime` multiplies the program’s structural T-gate count by its declared width, `2k + arcsinAncillas p`: two k-bit data registers plus clean workspace. The ambient wire count `n` does not enter the product; this is a gate-count metric, not T-depth or expected execution cost.

statements.section: D.1 Logical spacetime volume and architectural assumptions
statements.markdown: candidate circuits and literature baselines are compared at matched system encodings and error budgets
statements.note: Appendix F.2 gives a lower-bound cost estimate for the Häner et al. baseline, whose estimated maximum error is about $10^{-6}$. The Lean candidate’s bound is $1.25\times10^{-7}$ on the valid input grid. In Appendix H.1, the dynamics baseline assigns $0.01$ to the ancilla-zero block error. The authors derive a bound of about $0.041$ for the baseline’s full-output error. The candidate’s full-output bound is $0.01$.

statements.section: D.1 Logical spacetime volume and architectural assumptions
statements.markdown: our improvements hold under any monotone weighting of logical space and non-Clifford-gate count
statements.note: The authors report that each verified scientific simulation in Fig. 3b reduces both logical qubit count and non-Clifford gate count relative to its comparison baseline. Any cost function nondecreasing in those two coordinates therefore gives a value no greater than the baseline’s; this does not imply a strict reduction for every weighting or a reduction in physical runtime.
